integrity: The arbitrary-size construction and lower bound are proved symbolically; computational enumeration for carrier sizes four through eight is corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite carriers and exactly two-valued basic unary operations only; no claim on minimal operation count or the carrier spectra of larger nondistributive lattices. Historical priority not independently certified; Bandelt (1977) not inspected in full.
title: Every carrier size at least four realizes the pentagon with two-valued unary operations
